two actions source dark archives (remastered) pg. 104 traditions arcane, occult duration 10 minutes --- you exist in two places at once. when you cast the spell, another copy of yourself appears in an adjacent square. during bilocation's duration, whenever you act, you can choose which of your selves does so, and whenever one of you uses a move action, you can both move. your two selves share hit points, and any condition or effect on one affects both. if both of your selves are in the area of the same effect, or targeted by the same multitarget effect, you are only affected once. even if you are reduced to 0 hit points or killed, both selves remain until the duration expires. your link continues at any distance, even across planar boundaries. you can dismiss the spell, and if you do so, you choose which of the selves vanishes and which becomes you, allowing you to extricate one of your selves from a dangerous situation.
summary: You exist in two places at once.

description:
You transform a thrall into fine dust particles that invade a creature’s body and begin transforming their body into a statue made of pure enhanced bone. Destroy a thrall within range, and choose a living or undead creature within 60 feet of where the thrall was. The creature begins solidifying into pure bone depending on its Fortitude save. Creatures already made purely of bone, such as [skeletons](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=472), are immune to this spell. An [incorporeal](/Traits.aspx?ID=632) creature [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) by this spell loses the incorporeal trait and all associated resistances for the duration of the spell. **Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creature is [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) 1 and has weakness 5 to bludgeoning for 1 round.
**Failure** The creature is slowed 1 and has weakness 10 to bludgeoning for as long as it’s slowed. The creature must attempt an additional Fortitude save at the end of each of its turns; this ongoing save has the incapacitation trait. On a failed save, the slowed condition increases by 1 (or 2 on a critical failure) as bone growths creep across the creature’s body. A successful save reduces the slowed condition by 1. When a creature becomes fully unable to act due to the slowed condition from calcification, the spell then ends, leaving the creature [petrified](/Conditions.aspx?ID=87) permanently as it becomes a bony statue. The spell also ends if the slowed condition is removed, which causes the bone to break off harmlessly.
**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target is initially slowed 2.

description: You cause the magic within the target to dissipate in a destructive explosion. You attempt to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) the target. If the attempt succeeds, an explosion of magical force deals 8d6 force damage with a basic Reflex save. If you successfully counteract the magic of an item, it's deactivated for 1 week (or destroyed on a critical success) and the explosion is a 5-foot emanation from the item. If you successfully counteract a spell, the effect ends and the explosion affects either all creatures in the spells' area or the target of the spell and all creatures in a 5-foot emanation around it.

description:
You manipulate the boundaries between planes like a scalpel, using it to cut away portions of a creature’s essence and banishing those portions to other realities and dimensions, afflicting the target deep lacerations or even severed appendages. The creature takes 14d10 damage (no damage type) and 2d10 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86) and must attempt a Will save. If the target is not on its home plane, it takes a –4 status penalty to this save. A creature reduced to 0 HP has their entire body sectioned out and banished across multiple planes and dimensions, leaving nothing behind but their gear.


**Heightened (10th)** The base damage increases by 2d10, and the persistent bleed damage by 1d10.

description:
You reach into the skies and call down an array of falling stars that explode upon colliding with the ground. Choose for the falling stars to be airbursts ([sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147)), asteroids ([fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72)), comets ([cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27)), or plasma ([electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56)). The spell gains the trait of the falling star type you chose. The four stars' central 10-foot bursts can't overlap. Each falling star deals 6d10 bludgeoning damage to each creature in the 10-foot burst at the center of its area of effect before exploding, dealing 14d6 energy damage of the type you chose to each creature in its 40-foot burst. A creature in any of the areas attempts one basic Reflex save against the spell no matter how many overlapping explosions it's caught in and can take each type of damage only once.


**Heightened (+1)** The bludgeoning damage increases by 1d10, and the energy damage increases by 2d6.

description:
You gain a sixth sense that warns you of danger that might befall the target of the spell. If you choose a creature other than yourself as the target, you create a psychic link through which you can inform the target of danger. This link is a [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106) effect. Due to the amount of information this spell requires you to process, you can't have more than one _foresight_ spell in effect at a time. Casting _foresight_ again ends the previous _foresight_.

 While _foresight_ is in effect, the target gains a +2 status bonus to initiative rolls and isn't [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) against [undetected](/Conditions.aspx?ID=39) creatures or when flanked. In addition, you gain the following reaction.

 **Foresight** <actions string="Reaction" /> **Trigger** The target of _foresight_ defends against a hostile creature or other danger; **Effect** If the hostile creature or danger forces the target to roll dice (a saving throw, for example), the target rolls twice and uses the higher result, and this spell gains the [fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=76) trait. But if the hostile creature or danger is rolling against the target (an attack roll or skill check, for example), that hostile creature or danger rolls twice and uses the lower result, and this spell gains the [misfortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=110) trait.

description:
You transport yourself and your allies to a peaceful extraplanar realm of towering trees, each of which holds a misty gateway to another location. When you [Cast this Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=2734), you choose a specific destination within 1,000 miles that you can identify by its position relative to your starting position and by its appearance (or other identifying features). Incorrect knowledge of the location causes the spell to fail. You and your allies walk for 1 hour through the forest, and each of you regains Hit Points and reduces the value of any [doomed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=67) or [drained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68) condition as if you’d taken a [full night’s rest](/Rules.aspx?ID=2601). At the end of the journey, you attempt a DC 40 [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35) or [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43) check to find the correct gate to your desired location. **Critical Success** You and your allies arrive within 1,000 feet of your desired location.
**Success** You and your allies arrive within 1 mile of your desired location.
**Failure** You and your allies arrive within 10 miles of your desired location.
**Critical Failure** You and your allies exit the forest within 1 mile of your original location.
features: you and up to 6 willing creatures touched

When you Cast this Spell, you can [relocate](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) each affected target to any other unoccupied space within the emanation. You can't move yourself in this way. An unwilling target can resist being moved with a successful Reflex save.

 The creatures move all at once—after you know the results of all the saves, you determine which target occupies each space in whatever order you choose. If you move a target into the air, it descends to the ground harmlessly after being moved unless it chooses not to.

description:
You merge with an adjacent natural feature with enough volume to fit you and your worn and held possessions, such as the ground or a large tree. Your merged form is visible within the feature, and creatures can target and attack you normally, though you have cover and can use it to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) or [Take Cover](/Actions.aspx?ID=2307) within the feature. You can cast spells while in the feature as long as they don’t require line of effect beyond the feature. You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) the spell. While merged, you gain the following additional benefits.
  • You immediately become aware of the surrounding terrain features, and you gain [tremorsense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=82) as an [imprecise sense](/Rules.aspx?ID=2405) with a range of 200 feet.
  • You can make terrain vengeance Strikes by commanding plants, rocks, and other natural features to attack your foes. These are melee Strikes that use your spell attack modifier, can target any creature within 60 feet of you, and deal 5d12 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. You choose the damage type each time you make a terrain vengeance Strike.
  • By spending a single action, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561) trait, you can increase or decrease the [environmental temperature](/Rules.aspx?ID=2820), changing it to either one step warmer than normal, one step colder than normal, or the normal temperature.
  • As a 2-action activity that has the concentrate trait, you can create or remove [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) caused by natural terrain in a 20-foot [burst](/Rules.aspx?ID=2385) within 200 feet.
All your alterations to the land end when the spell ends. Significant physical damage to the natural feature while you are inside it expels you and deals 10d6 damage to you.

description:

description:
You implant an [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=26), magical eye sensor on the target's body. The eye has sight and vision, but no other special senses. The eye is highly contagious—the first two times  the target touches another creature during the duration, the spell buds off an additional eye that implants itself on that creature, which can then bud off two eyes of its own. This process can propagate up to four times from the original target, for a potential maximum of 31 eyes if each affected creature touches two new creatures.

 You can switch between perceiving through your own senses or the vision of any of the eye sensors using a single action, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) trait. You always know how many eyes there are and can tell which original eyes budded off to make which new eyes, though you gain no special insight into the identity of the new targets other than what you can glean from spying on them.

description:
Drawing from deep wells of spiritual power, you take on a special qi form. In your qi form, your hair, feathers, skin, or scales change color and begin to glow. In this form, you gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed. Choose force, spirit, vitality, or void damage. All your Strikes deal 1d6 additional damage of the chosen type. Your entire body is also surrounded by a glowing corona of the same color as your inner qi; this is a [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=640) effect. Your corona is an aura in a 5-foot emanation that deals 2d6 damage of the chosen type to creatures who start their turn within the emanation. If the emanation overlaps with a [darkness](/Traits.aspx?ID=569) effect, the corona's glow attempts to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) the darkness. Regardless of the outcome, the corona can't attempt to counteract that effect again for 1 day. You can Sustain to flare your corona out to become a 30-foot emanation or return the corona to a 5-foot emanation.

 In your qi form, your emotions surge to the forefront, and it's difficult to moderate your attacks. Your weapons and unarmed attacks lose the [nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=661) trait. You take a –2 status penalty to saves against [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590) effects but gain a +2 status bonus to saves against all other [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) effects.

description:
You launch a thrall up to 30 feet into the corpse of an enemy that has been dead for no more than 1 minute, destroying the thrall in an effort to call the corpse to fight. Attempt an [Undead Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=41) check against the standard DC of the level of enemy you’re trying to reanimate. You can reanimate only corpses of creatures that were once living or undead. **Success** The enemy reanimates in an unoccupied space adjacent to its corpse. It’s under your control and has the minion trait. It has the same attack modifier, AC, saving throw modifiers, Perception, and skill modifiers, but it has only 100 Hit Points and lacks all special abilities, including immunities, resistances, and weaknesses. It has no magic items except the weapons and armor it used before death. Its Strikes deal the normal damage but don’t apply added effects since the creature doesn’t have special abilities. The reanimated foe is unstable and decays quickly. Each turn after it takes its actions, it loses 15 Hit Points. It can’t regain its lost Hit Points in any way. The reanimated creature lasts for 1 minute or until it’s reduced to 0 Hit Points.
**Failure** As success, but the reanimated enemy deals half damage with its Strikes and loses 50 Hit Points each turn instead of 15.
**Critical Failure** You create a thrall in the corpse’s space, but you don’t spend the Focus Point for casting this spell.

description:

  • Due to the unbalanced body weight and mismatched limbs, the target takes a –20-foot status penalty to its Speeds.
  • The creature's mind and body no longer align, making it [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61), [drained 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68), [enfeebled 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71), and [stupefied 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94).
  • The target's new eyes make depth perception difficult; the target becomes [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65).
  • Whenever the target would regain actions at the start of its turn, it must first attempt a DC 5 [flat check](/Rules.aspx?ID=333); on a failure, it's [slowed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) for a round.
**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Failure** The target is affected for 1 minute.
**Critical Failure** The effect is permanent.

description:
You conjure a towering mansion up to four stories tall and up to 300 feet on a side. While Casting the Spell, you hold an image of the mansion and its desired appearance in your mind. The mansion can contain as many or as few rooms as you desire, and it's decorated as you imagine it. You can imagine a purpose for each room of the mansion, and the proper accouterments appear within. Any furniture or other mundane fixtures function normally for anyone inside the mansion, but they cease to exist if taken beyond its walls. No fixture created with this spell can create magical effects, but magical devices brought into the mansion function normally.
Your mansion contains the same types and quantities of foodstuffs and servants as created by the [_planar palace_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1634) spell. Each of the mansion's exterior doorways and windows are protected by [_alarm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1439) spells. You choose whether each alarm is audible or mental as you Cast the Spell, and each has a different sound (for an audible alarm) or sensation (for a mental one), allowing you to instantly determine which portal has been used.

description: You and your allies make a sacred pact with each other, ensuring that no matter what happens, your quest will be complete. All creatures are bound by your deity’s edicts and anathema. Violating an anathema ends the spell effect on the creature that committed the anathema, but nobody else. When a target would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed, it avoids being knocked out and continues to fight. It remains at 1 Hit Point, gains 50 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute, and increases its [wounded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=99) condition by 1. Each target can only avoid being knocked out in this way once, then becomes immune to _sacred covenant_ until its next daily preparations.

description:
You trap the target's soul in the item before the soul can pass on to the afterlife. The item used to contain the soul can be anything as long as it's of the appropriate value. The item has AC 16 and its normal Hardness and HP. Destroying (not just breaking) an item or [counteracting](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) _seize soul_ releases the soul to the afterlife. While the soul is in the item, the target can't be returned to life through any means, even powerful magic such as a _wish_ ritual. description:
The sky above you darkens in a matter of moments, swirling with ominous clouds punctuated by flashes of lighting. When you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain it each turn on subsequent rounds, select one of the following effects to occur in the area.
  • **Calm** No additional effect.
  • **Fog** Heavy fog rolls in, with the effects of [_mist_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1606).
  • **Rain** Torrential rain falls from the sky, dousing ordinary flames. Creatures in the area take a –2 circumstance penalty to [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) and Perception checks.
  • **Wind** Powerful winds buffet the area in all directions. Ranged attacks take a –4 circumstance penalty, and the area is difficult terrain for flying creatures.
In addition, once per round you can use a single action, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) and [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104) traits, to call down a bolt of lightning, striking any target in range that you can see. You deal 10d6 electricity damage to the target; it must attempt a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save. On a failure, it is also [deafened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=8) for 1 round.

description:
You create a cone of shimmering energy that attempts to banish the influence of invasive, supernatural blight, such as that found in Tanglebriar. Blighted [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) in the area becomes regular terrain, while blighted greater difficult terrain becomes difficult terrain; [hazardous terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2368) in the area becomes nonhazardous. These effects persist for 1 hour. Creatures in the area that carry features of this blight (as determined by the GM, but automatically including all creatures with the fiend trait in this adventure) are trimmed as well, their supernatural infusion of blight being drained. These creatures take 12d10 [spirit](/Traits.aspx?ID=737) damage and must attempt a Fortitude save. **Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creature takes half damage.
**Failure** The creature’s reach with attacks is reduced by 5 feet (to a minimum of 5 feet) for 1 hour, they are [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91) 1 and [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) 1 for 1 round.
**Critical Failure** The creature’s reach is reduced to 5 feet for 1 hour, they are sickened 2 and slowed 1 for 1 minute. **Heightened (10th)** The spirit damage increases by 2d10, and 1 hour durations increase to 24 hours.

description:
A long-forgotten army in the Darklands attempted to clinch a crucial battle by blacking out the sun with an impossible spell. The sun goes dark across the entire area of the spell, manipulating your enemies and giving your allies great resilience. The spell’s area comes under a 9th-rank _darkness_ spell. You and all allies in the area gain [greater darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), 40 temporary Hit Points, and a +3 status bonus to saving throws for the spell’s duration. Enemies within the area take a –3 status penalty to Will saving throws. Whenever you Fuel _Under Sunless Skies_, you cast a 9th-rank _command_ spell without expending a spell slot, targeting all enemies within the area. You must give the same command to all enemies.



**Lethologic Mark** Your sight becomes easily affected by light. When first exposed to [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407), you become [blinded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=59) until the end of your next turn. After this exposure, light doesn't blind you again until after you spend 1 hour in [darkness](/Rules.aspx?ID=409). To heal this mark, you must drink a potion created with a vial of black blood created by the Groetan hags of the Sightless Sea.

description:
You steal the blood and life force of other creatures around you and sometimes share their energies with your allies. You deal 12d6 void damage to living enemies in the area with a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines the area and other parameters. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the damage a single creature takes from this spell; calculate these temporary Hit Points using the creature that took the most damage. Any temporary Hit Points gained through this spell are lost after 1 minute.
The spell is a 20-foot emanation.
The spell is a 20-foot emanation. In addition to granting temporary Hit Points to yourself, you grant the same number of temporary Hit Points to all allies in the emanation.
**Two Rounds** If you spend 3 actions casting the spell, you can avoid finishing the spell and spend another 2 actions on your next turn to empower the spell even further. You can take other actions before finishing this spell, but the spell is lost if you Cast another Spell in between. The spell’s area increases to a 30-foot emanation, and the temporary Hit Points gained equal the highest damage a single creature took from the spell. After dealing damage, you can then teleport up to 60 feet to a location you can see. You can then grant all allies in a 30-foot emanation the same number of temporary Hit Points you gained.

two actions to 2 rounds source impossible magic pg. 169 traditions arcane, divine, occult area varies defense basic fortitude --- you steal the blood and life force of other creatures around you and sometimes share their energies with your allies. you deal 12d6 void damage to living enemies in the area with a basic fortitude save. the number of actions you spend when casting this spell determines the area and other parameters. you gain temporary hit points equal to half the damage a single creature takes from this spell; calculate these temporary hit points using the creature that took the most damage. any temporary hit points gained through this spell are lost after 1 minute. two actions the spell is a 20-foot emanation. three actions the spell is a 20-foot emanation. in addition to granting temporary hit points to yourself, you grant the same number of temporary hit points to all allies in the emanation. two rounds if you spend 3 actions casting the spell, you can avoid finishing the spell and spend another 2 actions on your next turn to empower the spell even further. you can take other actions before finishing this spell, but the spell is lost if you cast another spell in between. the spell’s area increases to a 30-foot emanation, and the temporary hit points gained equal the highest damage a single creature took from the spell. after dealing damage, you can then teleport up to 60 feet to a location you can see. you can then grant all allies in a 30-foot emanation the same number of temporary hit points you gained.
summary: Steal the life of your enemies and perhaps share some with your allies.

description:
You create a powerful and hungry spirit entity that grows and builds strength by consuming the spirits of foes you both slay. When you Cast the Spell, the gestalt deals 14d6 void damage to all living creatures of your choice in the area, with a basic Fortitude save. Creatures you choose that end their turns in the area take 6d6 void damage, with a basic Fortitude save.

At the end of each of your turns, if you killed a living creature during that turn or if the gestalt’s damage killed a creature since the end of your last turn, you add the slain creature’s soul to the gestalt. The emanation’s radius increases by 20 feet, and the damage dealt by the aura increases by 1d6. (Note that this increase only happens once, even if you killed multiple living creatures that turn.) As normal for determining threat level, the GM determines if a creature is of significant enough threat to empower the gestalt; in general, a creature several levels below you rarely poses a significant threat. **Heightened (10th)** The initial damage increases to 16d6, and the aura’s damage starts at 7d6.

description:
An immense weapon of spiritual energy appears, hovering in the air above the target. The weapon has the ghostly visual appearance of your deity's favored weapon. Name war or peace when you cast this spell.

 If you name “war,” mentally choose one creature. This must be a creature both you and the target can see. The target instinctively knows which creature this is. At the end of each of the target's turns, if the target didn't use a [hostile action](/Rules.aspx?ID=300) against the creature you chose during that turn, the weapon Strikes the target.

 If you name “peace,” mentally choose up to five allies. The target instinctively knows who those allies are. The weapon Strikes the target each time the target uses a hostile action against you or one of the chosen allies. The weapon Strikes only once per action, even if the action targets multiple allies (such as for a [_fireball_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1530) or a [Whirlwind Strike](/Feats.aspx?ID=4847)).

 Strikes with the weapon are melee weapon attacks, but they use your spell attack modifier. Regardless of its appearance, the weapon deals 4d10 damage. The damage type is the same as the chosen weapon (or any of its types for a [versatile](/Traits.aspx?ID=724) weapon). The attack deals spirit damage instead if that would be more detrimental to the creature (as determined by the GM). No other statistics or attributes of the weapon apply, and even a ranged weapon attacks adjacent creatures only. The weapon takes a multiple attack penalty, which increases throughout the target's turn, but its penalty is separate from yours.

 A weapon of judgment is a weapon for the purposes of triggers, resistances, and so forth. The weapon doesn't take up space, grant flanking, or have any other attributes a creature would. The weapon can't make any attack other than its Strike, and feats or spells that affect weapons don't apply to this weapon.


**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d10.

description:
A massive storm cloud forms in the air above the area, spreading rain and gales. The wind imposes a –4 circumstance penalty to physical ranged attacks. The air in the area is greater difficult terrain for flying creatures. When you Cast this Spell and the first time each round you Sustain it on subsequent rounds, you can choose one of the following storm effects. You can't choose the same effect twice in a row.
  • **Blizzard** The driving snow deals 4d8 cold damage to each creature in or below the storm with no save. Everything in or beneath the cloud is [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4) by driving snow and any ground is difficult terrain.
  • **Hail** Each creature in or below the storm takes 4d10 bludgeoning damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save.
  • **Lightning** Choose up to 10 creatures in or below the storm to be struck by lightning. Each of them takes 7d6 electricity damage with a basic Reflex save.
  • **Tornado** A roughly cylindrical whirlwind appears in or below the cloud in a 30-foot radius. Each creature in the whirlwind is thrown 40 feet upward.
**Heightened (10th)** The range increases to 2,000 feet and the cloud is a 1,000-foot burst.

  • AC = 25 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
  • 30 temporary Hit Points.
  • [Darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=415).

  • [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) modifier of +35, unless your own is higher.
You also gain the specific abilities listed for your deity below:

description:
You call upon the unimaginable power of world-ending cataclysms, ripping a small piece of each cataclysm and combining them together into one horrifically powerful attack. The following effects come down upon all creatures in the area. Treat the resistances of creatures in the area as if they were 10 lower for the purpose of determining the cataclysm's damage. Each creature attempts one basic Reflex save that applies to all five types of damage.
  • Flesh-dissolving acid rain deals 3d10 acid damage.
  • A roaring earthquake shakes and bludgeons creatures on the ground, dealing 3d10 bludgeoning damage.
  • A blast of freezing wind deals 3d10 cold damage.
  • Incredible lightning lashes the area, dealing 3d10 electricity damage.
  • Beating winds churn across the sky, dealing 3d10 bludgeoning damage to creatures flying in the area.
  • An instant tsunami sweeps over creatures in the area, dealing 3d10 bludgeoning damage (doubled for creatures swimming in the area).
  • A massive wildfire burns in a sudden inferno, dealing 3d10 fire damage.

description:
You tap into the glories of the armies of old, bringing forth their might to your battlefield and making their strength and power your own. This army manifests as glimmering forms of a conquering military of old, replete with banners and colors of their nation. The army occupies the space of a Gargantuan creature and has a Speed of 80 feet. **Arrive** ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541), [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=598), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) _Banner’s Call_ The conquering army manifests before you and your allies, letting out a battle cry of victory and devotion. Each enemy within an 80-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) must attempt a Will save.
**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creature is [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) 2.
**Failure** The creature takes 6d12 mental damage and is frightened 3.
**Critical Failure** The creature takes 12d12 mental damage, is frightened 4, and is [fleeing](/Conditions.aspx?ID=74) for 1 round. **Depart** (emotion, [healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=623), mental) _Trumpets of War_ As the conquering soldiers begin to fade, their military musicians play one more triumphant song in your honor. You and all allies within 100 feet of the soldiers immediately reduce the value of any [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61), [drained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68), [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71), frightened, [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91), and [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) conditions by 2 and gain a +2 status bonus to all attacks, saving throws, skill checks, and DCs for 3 rounds.

description: You conjure forth a massive tower with a large dragon that’s bound to crawl its length. The dragon and the tower share the same space, and the dragon intercepts any attack targeting the tower. When the dragon dies, the tower crumbles. The dragon is immune to all conditions, has an AC of 40, a +30 modifier for all saving throws, and 250 Hit Points. When you Cast the Spell, and once per round when you Sustain it, the dragon unleashes its breath in a 60-foot [cone](/Rules.aspx?ID=2386), dealing 13d8 damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save). The damage type depends on the tradition used to cast this spell: **[arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1)** [force](/Traits.aspx?ID=610), **[divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2)** [spirit](/Traits.aspx?ID=737), **[occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)** [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), **[primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)** [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604).

description:
Drawing upon the elemental plane, you transform into a spectacular elemental. You can choose between an air elemental, earth elemental, fire elemental, metal elemental, water elemental, or wood elemental. Your battle form is Gargantuan, and you must have enough space to expand into, or the spell is lost. While in this form, you gain the [elemental](/Traits.aspx?ID=587) trait and the trait for the element you choose. You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) the spell. You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose:
  • AC = 25 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
  • 30 [temporary Hit Points](/Rules.aspx?ID=2321).
  • [Darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=415).
  • One or more attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +34, and your damage bonus is +15. These attacks are Dexterity based if you choose an air, fire, or metal elemental, or Strength based if you choose an earth, water, or wood elemental. (This distinction doesn't change the statistics but matters for the [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71) and [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) conditions, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.
  • [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) modifier of +36 for air, fire, or metal elemental, or [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) modifier of +36 for earth, water, or wood elemental, unless your own modifier is higher.
You also gain specific abilities based on the type of elemental you choose: - **Air Elemental** Speed [fly](/Rules.aspx?ID=2350) 80 feet; **High Winds** ([air](/Traits.aspx?ID=527), [aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542)) 30 feet. Air within the emanation is [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) for flying creatures that don’t have the air trait; **Swiftness** Your movement doesn’t trigger reactions; **Melee** gust ([reach 25 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684)), **Damage** 3d12 bludgeoning plus [Push](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=47) 10 feet; **Ranged** lightning lash ([range increment 80 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 3d10 electricity. - **Earth Elemental** Speed 30 feet, [burrow](/Rules.aspx?ID=2348) 20 feet; resistance 5 to physical; **Spike Stones** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=585)) 30 feet. The area is [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) and hazardous terrain. A creature without the earth trait that moves on the ground in the area takes 5 piercing damage for every square of that area it moves into; **Rocky Toughness** You gain 40 temporary Hit Points when you choose this form instead of 30; **Melee** fist ([reach 25 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684)), **Damage** 3d12 bludgeoning; **Ranged** rock ([range increment 40 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 3d8 bludgeoning. - **Fire Elemental** Speed 50 feet; [immunity](/Rules.aspx?ID=2313) to fire; [weakness](/Rules.aspx?ID=2317) 10 to cold; **Intense Heat** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604)) 30 feet. A creature that enters the aura or starts its turn in the aura takes 5d6 fire damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save against your spell DC. A creature can take damage from the aura only once per round; **Melee** tendril ([reach 25 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684)), **Damage** 3d10 fire plus 2d6 [persistent fire](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86); **Ranged** fire mote ([range increment 60 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 3d8 fire. - **Metal Elemental** Speed 40 feet, [fly](/Rules.aspx?ID=2350) 40 feet; resistance 10 to electricity; **Arcing Electricity** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=586), [metal](/Traits.aspx?ID=505)) 30 feet. A creature that enters the aura or starts its turn in the aura takes 2d12 electricity damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save against your spell DC; a creature made of metal, with the metal trait, or wearing metal armor takes a –1 circumstance penalty on this save. A creature can take damage from the aura only once per round; **Melee** blade ([reach 25 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684), [versatile S](/Traits.aspx?ID=724)), **Damage** 3d12 piercing; **Ranged** metal shard ([range increment 40 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248), [versatile S](/Traits.aspx?ID=724)), **Damage** 3d8 piercing. - **Water Elemental** Speed 40 feet, [swim](/Rules.aspx?ID=2351) 80 feet; resistance 10 to fire; **Vortex** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=732)) 30 feet. Water within the aura that is part of the same body of water you occupy is [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) for Swimming creatures that don’t have the [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=732) trait; **Melee** wave ([reach 25 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684)), **Damage** 3d12 bludgeoning plus [Push](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=47) or Pull 10 feet; **Ranged** water spout ([range increment 60 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 3d8 bludgeoning. - **Wood Elemental** Speed 30 feet, [climb](/Rules.aspx?ID=2349) 35 feet; [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) 5 to physical; [weakness](/Rules.aspx?ID=2317) 10 to [axes](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=1); **Lush Growth** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [wood](/Traits.aspx?ID=508)) 30 feet. Ground in the area is [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366), and any time a creature in the area regains HP from a [healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=623) [vitality](/Traits.aspx?ID=509) effect, the aura grants a +5 status bonus to the healing; **Woody Toughness** You gain 40 temporary Hit Points when you choose this form instead of 30; **Melee** branch ([reach 25 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684)), **Damage** 3d10 bludgeoning; **Ranged** seed ([range increment 40 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 3d8 bludgeoning.

You can choose between an air elemental, earth elemental, fire elemental, metal elemental, water elemental, or wood elemental. Your battle form is Gargantuan, and you must have enough space to expand into, or the spell is lost. While in this form, you gain the [elemental](/Traits.aspx?ID=587) trait and the trait for the element you choose. You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) the spell. You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose:
  • AC = 25 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
  • 30 [temporary Hit Points](/Rules.aspx?ID=2321).
  • [Darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=415).
  • One or more attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +34, and your damage bonus is +15. These attacks are Dexterity based if you choose an air, fire, or metal elemental, or Strength based if you choose an earth, water, or wood elemental. (This distinction doesn't change the statistics but matters for the [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71) and [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) conditions, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.
  • [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) modifier of +36 for air, fire, or metal elemental, or [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) modifier of +36 for earth, water, or wood elemental, unless your own modifier is higher.
You also gain specific abilities based on the type of elemental you choose: - **Air Elemental** Speed [fly](/Rules.aspx?ID=2350) 80 feet; **High Winds** ([air](/Traits.aspx?ID=527), [aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542)) 30 feet. Air within the emanation is [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) for flying creatures that don’t have the air trait; **Swiftness** Your movement doesn’t trigger reactions; **Melee** gust ([reach 25 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684)), **Damage** 3d12 bludgeoning plus [Push](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=47) 10 feet; **Ranged** lightning lash ([range increment 80 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 3d10 electricity. - **Earth Elemental** Speed 30 feet, [burrow](/Rules.aspx?ID=2348) 20 feet; resistance 5 to physical; **Spike Stones** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=585)) 30 feet. The area is [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) and hazardous terrain. A creature without the earth trait that moves on the ground in the area takes 5 piercing damage for every square of that area it moves into; **Rocky Toughness** You gain 40 temporary Hit Points when you choose this form instead of 30; **Melee** fist ([reach 25 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684)), **Damage** 3d12 bludgeoning; **Ranged** rock ([range increment 40 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 3d8 bludgeoning. - **Fire Elemental** Speed 50 feet; [immunity](/Rules.aspx?ID=2313) to fire; [weakness](/Rules.aspx?ID=2317) 10 to cold; **Intense Heat** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604)) 30 feet. A creature that enters the aura or starts its turn in the aura takes 5d6 fire damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save against your spell DC. A creature can take damage from the aura only once per round; **Melee** tendril ([reach 25 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684)), **Damage** 3d10 fire plus 2d6 [persistent fire](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86); **Ranged** fire mote ([range increment 60 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 3d8 fire. - **Metal Elemental** Speed 40 feet, [fly](/Rules.aspx?ID=2350) 40 feet; resistance 10 to electricity; **Arcing Electricity** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=586), [metal](/Traits.aspx?ID=505)) 30 feet. A creature that enters the aura or starts its turn in the aura takes 2d12 electricity damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save against your spell DC; a creature made of metal, with the metal trait, or wearing metal armor takes a –1 circumstance penalty on this save. A creature can take damage from the aura only once per round; **Melee** blade ([reach 25 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684), [versatile S](/Traits.aspx?ID=724)), **Damage** 3d12 piercing; **Ranged** metal shard ([range increment 40 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248), [versatile S](/Traits.aspx?ID=724)), **Damage** 3d8 piercing. - **Water Elemental** Speed 40 feet, [swim](/Rules.aspx?ID=2351) 80 feet; resistance 10 to fire; **Vortex** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=732)) 30 feet. Water within the aura that is part of the same body of water you occupy is [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) for Swimming creatures that don’t have the [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=732) trait; **Melee** wave ([reach 25 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684)), **Damage** 3d12 bludgeoning plus [Push](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=47) or Pull 10 feet; **Ranged** water spout ([range increment 60 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 3d8 bludgeoning. - **Wood Elemental** Speed 30 feet, [climb](/Rules.aspx?ID=2349) 35 feet; [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) 5 to physical; [weakness](/Rules.aspx?ID=2317) 10 to [axes](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=1); **Lush Growth** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [wood](/Traits.aspx?ID=508)) 30 feet. Ground in the area is [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366), and any time a creature in the area regains HP from a [healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=623) [vitality](/Traits.aspx?ID=509) effect, the aura grants a +5 status bonus to the healing; **Woody Toughness** You gain 40 temporary Hit Points when you choose this form instead of 30; **Melee** branch ([reach 25 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684)), **Damage** 3d10 bludgeoning; **Ranged** seed ([range increment 40 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 3d8 bludgeoning.

description:
Choose a single statement you want the targets to believe. The fact could be narrow, such as “a dragon is circling overhead and wants to kill me”; wide-reaching, such as “all humanoids are disguised abominations”; or conceptual, such as “if I don't live a kinder life, I'll be punished in the afterlife.” The targets' experiences color how they react to this “truth” and how their behavior changes. If the statement changes what they perceive, they treat the change as a sudden revelation. The effect of the spell depends on the targets' Will saves. If a target is already affected by _fabricated truth_, your spell tries to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) it. If the counteract check fails, the outcome of the target's saving throw can't be worse than a success. **Critical Success** The target doesn't believe the statement, and it knows you tried to trick it.
**Success** The target doesn't believe the statement or realize you tried to trick it.
**Failure** The target believes the statement for 1 week.
**Critical Failure** The target believes the statement with unlimited duration.

description:
You perform music so perfect that the target may die of joy or sorrow. Once targeted, the creature becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute. The effect of the spell depends on the target's level and current Hit Points. **16th or Lower** The target dies instantly.

**18th or Higher** The target takes 50 damage. If this brings it to 0 Hit Points, it dies instantly.

description:
You weave the threads of fate to lead two foes into a climactic battle. The targets of this spell are the fated opponents: one of the targets of this spell must be you or a willing ally, and the other must be an enemy. When you Cast the Spell, the ally you targeted (or you, if you targeted yourself) can teleport to any unoccupied space of their choice within 30 feet of their fated opponent. This is a [teleportation](/Traits.aspx?ID=710) effect.

 You isolate the two targets for 1 round. During this time, fate refuses to allow either fated opponent to be affected by attacks or effects from a third party; a fated opponent could be affected by the other's [_falling stars_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1521) or its own [_heal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1554) spell, but it would be entirely immune to a spell or Strike from a creature outside of the spells effects, including damage from a hazard or the environment. This doesn't apply to anything that was affecting the targets before you cast fated confrontation (such as a spell with a duration or [persistent damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) the creature had before it was affected by fated confrontation).

 For the duration of the spell, either fated opponent can manipulate fate once on each of its turns. This allows it to either roll twice and take the higher result on an attack roll or skill check it attempts against its fated opponent (a [fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=612) effect) or force the fated opponent to roll twice on a saving throw against one of its abilities and take the lower result (a [misfortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=654) effect).

 This spell ends if either target becomes unable to act, or if they both agree to cease hostilities.
features: you or 1 willing ally and 1 enemy

description: You temporarily stop time for everything but yourself, allowing you to use several actions in what appears to others to be no time at all. Immediately after casting _freeze time_, you can use up to 9 actions in 3 sets of up to 3 actions each. After each set of actions, 1 round passes, but for only you, effects specifically targeting or affecting you, and effects that you create during the stoppage. All other creatures and objects are invulnerable to your attacks, and you can't target or affect them with anything. Once you have finished your actions, time begins to flow again for the rest of the world. If you created an effect with a duration that extends beyond _freeze time's_ duration, such as [_wall of fire_](/Spells.aspx?ID=362), it immediately affects others again, but it doesn't have any of the effects that happen only when you first Cast the Spell.

description: You tear open a rift to another plane, creating a portal that creatures can travel through in either direction. This portal is vertical and circular, with a radius of 40 feet. The portal appears at a location of your choice on the destination plane, assuming you have a clear idea of both the destination's location on the plane and what the destination looks like. If you attempt to create a _gate_ into or out of the realm of a deity or another similarly powerful being, that being can prevent the gate from forming.

description: You shout in defiance and are filled with a burst of healing. Just before applying the attack's damage, you recover 6d8+20 Hit Points. If this is enough to prevent the attack from bringing you to 0 Hit Points, you don't become [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=95) or dying. Either way, cheating death is difficult, and you can't use _hero's defiance_ again until you [Refocus](/Actions.aspx?ID=2621) or make your daily preparations. _Hero's defiance_ can't be used against effects with the [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=571) trait or that would leave no remains, such as [_disintegrate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1492).
features: An attack would bring you to 0 Hit Points.

You briefly conjure a kaiju, a massive, rampaging monster with a unique name and legendary reputation. It rises from its secluded lair to annihilate your foes. The summoned kaiju occupies the space of a Gargantuan creature. When you Cast this Spell, choose one of the kaiju below to summon.

- **Agmazar, the Star Titan** Speed 100 feet, climb 50 feet; **Arrive** ([void](/Traits.aspx?ID=510)) _Channel Void_ Each foe in a 100-foot emanation takes 16d8 void damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Fortitude save); **Depart** _Gravitic Repulsion_ Each foe in a 50-foot emanation is [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 100 feet away unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save.

- **Agyra, the Forever Storm** Speed 80 feet, fly 200 feet; **Arrive** ([electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=586)) _Breath of a Thousand Storms_ Agyra shoots two 1,200-foot lines of electricity, one from each of her heads. The lines can't overlap. Each creature along one of the lines takes 6d12 electricity damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save. On a failure, the creature is also [slowed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) for 1 round (for 1 minute on a critical failure); **Depart** ([sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=697)) _Thunderous Blast_ Each creature within a 100-foot emanation takes 6d10 sonic damage with a basic Reflex save and is also knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88) on a failed save.

- **Bezravnis, the Inferno Below** Speed 100 feet, burrow 100 feet; **Arrive** ([earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=585)) _Burrow from the Earth's Heart_ Bezravnis explodes from the ground where it was summoned, causing all creatures in a 50-foot emanation to take 8d12 bludgeoning damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save. This potentially collapses structures with the collapse effect of the _[_earthquake_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1507)_ spell, except there's no chance of falling into a fissure; **Depart** _Web Hurricane_ Bezravnis departs with a hurricane of webbing. All creatures within a 50-foot emanation must succeed at a Reflex save or take a –20-foot circumstance penalty to their Speeds until they [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) (or are [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=81) until they Escape on a critical failure). The Escape DC is your spell DC.

- **Ebeshra, the Winged Razor** Speed 75 feet, fly 100 feet; **Arrive** ([teleportation](/Traits.aspx?ID=710)) _Planar Draw_ Each foe in a 100-foot emanation is [pulled](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 50 feet toward the center, unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save. Creatures that fail and reach the center take 10d6 bludgeoning damage; **Depart** ([electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=586)) _Storm Discharge_ All creatures in a 240-foot line takes 12d8 electricity damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save.

- **Mogaru, the Final King** Speed 100 feet, swim 100 feet; **Arrive** ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) _Trance of the King's Melody_ Mogaru manifests with a burst of the song that summoned him, requiring all foes within 60 feet who can hear him to attempt a Will save, leaving them [stunned 3](/Conditions.aspx?ID=93) on a failure; **Depart** ([fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604)) _Volcanic Breath_ Mogaru unleashes his scorching breath in a 120-foot cone. Each creature in the area takes 10d6 fire damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save. On a failure, it also takes 4d6 [persistent fire damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86).

- **Vorgozen, the Shapeless Feeder** Speed 50 feet, climb 50 feet, swim 100 feet; **Arrive** _Pollute Magic_ Vorgozen's foul presence pollutes magic around her. Each enemy within a 60-foot emanation that's under the effects of a spell must attempt a Fortitude save. On a failure, the creature is [sickened 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91). Any of your enemies that Casts a Spell within 60 feet of Vorgozen must attempt a Fortitude save with the same effects unless it's already sickened; **Depart** ([acid](/Traits.aspx?ID=524)) _Beam of Purest Vitriol_ Each creature in a 1,200-foot line takes 10d6 acid damage and 10d6 bludgeoning damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Fortitude save.

- **Yarthoon, the Moon Grub** Speed 60 feet, burrow 100 feet, fly 100 feet, swim 100 feet; **Arrive** ([cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=555)) _Algid Beam Barrage_ Yarthoon fires countless beams, targeting each of your enemies within 200 feet of it. The beams deal 10d6 cold damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save; **Depart** (cold, [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=732)) _Frostbite Mist_ Chilling mist surges out in a 100-foot burst centered on Yarthoon and remains for 1 minute. This mist has the effects of _[_mist_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1606)_, plus any creature within the area at the end of its turn takes 5d6 cold damage (basic Fortitude save).

description:
You bartered for this spell in some strange market or perhaps gained it while wandering the desert, hopelessly lost and surrounded by nothing but the remnants of time and fallen empires. With a gesture and words of a language not spoken since the fall of the Hanging City of Teskra, you summon Jassim the Wanderer. Jassim, a true Jistkan automaton, occupies the space of a Gargantuan creature and has a Speed of 60 feet. 

**Arrive** ([fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604)) _Eyes of Fire_ Jassim emerges from the ground and glares at your enemies, a fearsome look forming on a face of ancient metal and glass. He shoots an energy beam in a 60-foot [line](/Rules.aspx?ID=2388), dealing 5d12 fire damage and 5d12 piercing damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save). Enemies that critically fail are [drained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68) 2. 

**Depart** ([metal](/Traits.aspx?ID=505)) _Heart of Rust_ Jassim takes a metal piece from his chest and holds it out, crushing it in his fist and allowing the powder to spread across a 60-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387). These particles deal 10d6 slashing damage to all creatures and unattended objects within the area (basic Fortitude save). A metal creature that fails its save also takes 2d8 [persistent slashing damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86). A non-metal creature that fails this save is also [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91) 2.

Additionally, five thralls (using the base thrall statistics) fall from their graves into empty spaces adjacent to the _living graveyard_. This thrall has 400 Hit Points and a Speed of 60 feet. The living graveyard’s Strikes have a reach of 15 feet and deal bludgeoning damage. description:
The primal power of the world flows through you. You transform into an incarnation of nature, either a green man or a kaiju. Your battle form is Medium for a green man or Gargantuan (30-foot-by-30-foot space) for a kaiju. While in this form, you gain the [plant](/Traits.aspx?ID=125) trait (for a green man) or the [beast](/Traits.aspx?ID=20) trait (for a kaiju). You can Dismiss the spell. You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose:
  • AC = 25 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
  • 30 temporary Hit Points.
  • [Darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=415).
  • One or more attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +34, and you use the listed damage. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13) condition, for example). If your [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=199) attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.

description: You create a perfect thrall that’s the conglomeration of all aspects of necromancy. The perfected thrall is made of pure, dense muscle, covered in a layer of hardened bone, and inhabited by the spirit of a mighty warrior. It wields a weapon made of blood that forms into the ideal weapon for any situation before becoming harder than iron. You create a thrall that has 200 Hit Points and a Speed of 40 feet. Whenever you use an ability that would destroy this thrall, it instead loses 20 Hit Points. The spirit inhabiting this thrall can inspire other spirits to join the fray with their inspiring attacks. Whenever the perfected thrall critically hits a creature, you create up to 4 thralls, each of which must be adjacent to either the perfected thrall or the Strike’s target. When you use _thrall charge_ to order this thrall to [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306), the Strike deals an additional 6d6 damage.

description:
Your performance enraptures listeners, compelling them to follow you. Each creature within the emanation must attempt a Will save when you Cast the Spell or the first time they enter the area, after which they become temporarily immune for 1 day. Once per turn, you can Sustain the composition to increase the emanation's radius by 5 feet. You can Dismiss the spell. **Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creature is [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=14) with you.
**Failure** The creature is fascinated by you and uses all its actions to move toward you and compliment your performance. This effect ends if a [hostile action](/Rules.aspx?ID=300) is used against the affected creature.
**Critical Failure** The target gains the [minion](/Traits.aspx?ID=109) trait and is [controlled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=6) by you. This effect ends if a hostile action is used against the affected creature, or if you direct the creature to use any action that causes it harm.

description:
You rip out a portion of an elemental plane and smash it into your plane, unleashing a chaotic maelstrom. When you Cast this Spell, choose an elemental plane. The collision deals 8d6 force damage and 8d8 damage of a type depending on the chosen plane to each creature in the area with a basic Reflex save. A creature that fails the saving throw is also [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 25 feet away from the center of the burst (or 50 feet on a critical failure). Each creature whose movement is stopped by a firm surface, such as a well, takes bludgeoning damage equal to the remaining number of feet it would've moved. The area also becomes [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) and [hazardous terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=454) that lasts for a year and a day or until [counteracted](/Rules.aspx?ID=3280) by a spell or effect such as _dispel magic_. Any creature that ends its turn in the hazardous terrain takes 15 damage of a type depending on the chosen plane.

- **Plane of Air** The damage dealt is acid damage, and the spell gains the [air](/Traits.aspx?ID=527) trait.
- **Plane of Earth** The damage dealt is bludgeoning damage, and the spell gains the [earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=585) trait.
- **Plane of Fire** The damage dealt is fire damage, and the spell gains the [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604) trait.
- **Plane of Metal** The damage dealt is slashing damage, and the spell gains the [metal](/Traits.aspx?ID=505) trait.
- **Plane of Water** The damage dealt is cold damage, and the spell gains the [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=732) trait.
- **Plane of Wood** The damage dealt is piercing damage, and the spell gains the [wood](/Traits.aspx?ID=508) trait.

description:
You fully re-create an object from nothing, even if the object was destroyed. To do so, you must be able to picture the object in your mind. The remnant of the item can be small or insignificant (even a speck of dust that remains from [_disintegrate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=76) is enough). The spell fails if your imagination relied on too much guesswork; if the object would be too large to fit in a 5-foot cube; if the object still exists and you were simply not aware of it; or if the object is an artifact, has a level over 20, or has similar vast magical power.

 The item reassembles in perfect condition. Even if your mental image was of a damaged or weathered object, the new one is in this perfected form. If the object was [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), this spell typically restores its constant magical properties, but not any temporary ones, such as charges or one-time uses. An item with charges or uses per day has all of its uses expended when remade, but it replenishes them normally thereafter.

description:
You create dozens of semi-real copies of yourself that swarm across the battlefield and fight your enemies. You’re virtually indistinguishable from your clones, allowing you to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) and [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=2405) among them. An enemy that’s in the area when the spell is cast or that ends their turn in the area takes 3d10 mental damage and 3d10 bludgeoning damage, and is possibly inflicted with a condition, depending on the result of their Will save. When you Cast the Spell, you choose a condition your shadows impose on a failed save: [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) 2, [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71) 2, [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58), or [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) 1. **Critical Success** The creature takes no damage. For the duration of the spell, the creature uses the outcome one degree of success better than it rolled on further saves against the spell and can distinguish you from your clones without difficulty.
**Success** The creature takes half damage.
**Failure** The creature takes full damage and gains the chosen condition until the end of its next turn.
**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage and gains the chosen condition until the end of its next turn.

description:
You cause the barrier between the Universe and the Void to weaken as waves of void energy pull the living toward the tear to their inevitable doom. The area is [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) to all living creatures. When you Cast this Spell and the first time each round you Sustain it on subsequent rounds, all living creatures in the area must attempt a Fortitude saving throw.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.
**Success** The target takes 5d12 void damage and is pulled 15 feet toward the center.
**Failure** The target takes 10d12 void damage and is pulled 30 feet toward the center.
**Critical Failure** The target takes 20d12 void damage and is pulled 30 feet toward the center.

There’s an additional 5-foot burst in the center of the area that drains the life away from all who touch it. Whenever a living creature begins its turn in this burst, it becomes [drained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68) 1, or its drained condition increases by 1 to a maximum of drained 4. A target that is drained 4 and begins its turn in the center burst must attempt a Fortitude save that has the [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=571) and [incapacitation](/Traits.aspx?ID=631) traits; on a failure, it is reduced to 0 Hit Points, crumbles into ash, and becomes a wraith. The gear of the creature that’s transformed in this way falls to the ground in its space.

description: You spark the genesis of a new divine realm around you. The appearance of the area becomes more obviously divine, matching your own beliefs. All creatures within the area temporarily transcend into divine beings. If you’re holy, your allies gain the [holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517) trait, while your foes gain the [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521) trait and weakness 5 to holy. Similarly, if you’re unholy, your allies gain the unholy trait, while your foes gain the holy trait and weakness 5 to unholy. Creatures that already have the holy or unholy trait don’t gain any new traits or weaknesses. While in the area, you and all allies gain a fly Speed equal to their highest Speed, and their Strikes gain the sanctified trait and deal an additional 1d10 spirit damage on hit. Additionally, all enemies take 10 spirit damage whenever they’re critically hit by an attack or whenever they critically fail a saving throw.

description:
You conceal reality, letting time proceed, though none perceive it. Whenever a creature enters the area or starts its turn in the area, the creature must attempt a Will saving throw. A creature of 16th level or lower automatically critically fails. You can designate up to 10 creatures to be immune from this part of the spell. Regardless of the result, the creature becomes temporarily immune for the remainder of the duration. When this spell ends, all events that took place within the area are wiped from the memories of all creatures everywhere (including yourself and other excluded creatures), all records of the events are erased, and all attempts to receive any information about the events are automatically negated. Only an impossible spell specifically crafted for seeing a particular event can retrieve any knowledge of the events that took place. **Lethologic Mark** You become unremarkable in presence and sometimes slip outside of reality altogether. Those you meet forget your name and identity 1 hour after they leave your presence. Those who already knew you must succeed at a DC 5 flat check each morning; on a failure, they forget you and your identity until the next morning. If they forget you 3 days in a row, the effect lasts until the lethologic mark is removed. To heal this mark, you—or those willing to assist you—must learn and speak five of your true names successively, knowledge that has been scattered to the far corners of the [Dimension of Time](/Planes.aspx?ID=46). **Critical Success** The creature automatically learns you’re the spell’s caster, your current location, and the effect of the spell.
**Success** The creature is [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) 1 and knows you’re the spell’s caster.
**Failure** The creature is slowed 1 and can’t use reactions.
**Critical Failure** The creature is slowed 3 and can’t use reactions. When you Fuel Veil of Broken Reality, you cast freeze time without expending a spell slot.
